status: Provisional simulation, not a measured digital twin or hardware acceptance

source_hints.interpretation: Conventionally millimetres; source-code hints only. Joint centres, mapping and assembly revision are unverified. No vendor code or motion frames copied.

geometry_m.status: Estimated primitive mapping of source hints; radii, height, axes and pivot placements are estimated

estimated_mass_kg.status: All masses estimated; inertias and centres of mass are estimated from uniform primitive shapes by MuJoCo, not measured

estimated_joint_limits_rad.status: Simulation pivot conventions and conservative controller workspace only; compliant joint stops are estimated, not vendor angles or certified mechanical limits

estimated_actuator.status: Estimated position-servo surrogate with delay, deadband, slew and torque saturation; no calibrated motor/electrical/backlash model

estimated_contact.status: All friction and compliance estimated; rigid primitive contacts do not model real rubber feet

simulation.self_collision_status: Robot-to-robot collisions disabled in this provisional model; workspace is not certified collision-free

estimated_sensor.status: Synthetic delayed noisy forward ray against static arena, not a validated ultrasonic sensor model; no-echo is unknown

controller.status: Crab-owned independent IK and procedural sequential swing/stance; no learned policy, balance feedback, odometry, navigation or recovery
